digest.component_or_area: rebar-implement skill and shared test-design documentation
propositions: Five prose upgrades to implement-side skill and test-design targeting parity siblings, config read-miswire, op-level contention, gate findings without oracle upgrades, and residual gaps
Surface-parity census (section 4a) must enumerate CLI, MCP-API, library-facade, automated-callers, and dual-direction slots with in-scope-proven or out-of-scope-reason dispositions
Test-design section 6 requires config-effect contrast tests proving real read-path behavior change between default and non-default values for each config key
Contention triggers in section 4b route by shape: composed/check-then-act writes to two_clones fixture, write-storm/retry to storm suite, read-integrity to reads-under-sync-contention harness
Behavioral gate findings require RED test first in same change before fix; non-behavioral findings exempted to prevent change-detector false positives
Phase-5 residual-gap disposition sweep enumerates census out-of-scope slots, exclusions, compromises, and deferred advisories as filed/accepted/fixed with reasons
